images.filename: Kincaid Mounds State Historic Site HRoe 2012.jpg
images.caption: A digital illustration of the Kincaid Mounds Site, a Middle Mississippian Culture multi-mound site located in Massac and Pope Counties, Illinois. The Mississippian component of the site lasted from approximately 1050 to 1400 CE.
images.alt: A digital illustration of the Kincaid Mounds Site, a Middle Mississippian Culture multi-mound site located in Massac and Pope Counties, Illinois. The Mississippian component of the site lasted from approximately 1050 to 1400 CE.

images.caption: Artists conception of the late phase of the Kincaid Mounds Site circa 1300 CE. Kincaid is a Middle Mississippian Culture multi-mound archaeological site site located in Massac and Pope Counties, Illinois, USA. By this phase of the sites history the western portion (lower left in illustration) had been abandoned and the population was centered in the middle section of the site. All rights held by the artist, Herb Roe © 2017.
